```cypher
MATCH (m:Model {model_code: 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku:SKU)-[:CONTAINS]->(m)
WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
  AND date('2023-01-01') <= date('2026-10-01') AND (date('2026-10-01') <= date('2026-10-01') OR true)
WITH m, collect(DISTINCT sku.sku_id) AS direct_sku_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle:SKU)-[:CONTAINS*1..6]->(item_sku:SKU)-[:CONTAINS]->(m)
WHERE bundle.is_bundle = true AND item_sku.is_bundle = false
WITH m, direct_sku_ids, collect(DISTINCT item_sku.sku_id) AS bundle_item_sku_ids, collect(DISTINCT bundle.sku_id) AS bundle_sku_ids
WITH m, 
     apoc.coll.union(direct_sku_ids, bundle_item_sku_ids) AS all_sku_ids,
     bundle_sku_ids
UNWIND all_sku_ids AS sku_id
MATCH (sku:SKU {sku_id: sku_id})
MATCH (l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku)
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:HAS_LINE {qty: line_qty}]->(l)
WHERE so.status = 'completed'
  AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2023
WITH sku, so, line_qty, 
     CASE WHEN sku.sku_id IN bundle_item_sku_ids THEN true ELSE false END AS is_from_bundle,
     bundle_sku_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle:SKU)-[:CONTAINS {valid_from: bv_from, valid_to: bv_to}]->(sku)
WHERE bundle.sku_id IN bundle_sku_ids
  AND so.order_date >= bv_from AND (bv_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bv_to)
WITH sku, so, line_qty, is_from_bundle, bundle,
     CASE WHEN is_from_bundle AND bundle IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS valid_bundle_path
WITH sku, so, line_qty, is_from_bundle,
     CASE 
       WHEN NOT is_from_bundle THEN line_qty
       WHEN is_from_bundle AND valid_bundle_path THEN line_qty
       ELSE 0
     END AS effective_qty
RETURN sum(effective_qty) AS total_units_sold
```
